The current owned updater instead preserves non-null values and performs quiet deselection in _assignOptionValue when the actual model is nullish. This retains programmatic reactive reset while applying the latercf868 refinement. The added actual Angular regression first selects an option, then resets the reactive FormControl and checks both null model and deselected option. The current legacy suite only checks its typed text resets. Preserve that existing text assertion and add a real selection/reset cycle, including no option-selection emission. Source FormControl callbacks support the decision but do not execute this native regression.
